instructions: Start with a blank pdf project for edit-new?pdfjs=1
Start from a blank PDF project at edit-new?pdfjs=1
Several changes are per-browser preferences: use a fresh profile for first-run behaviour

tests.title: Setup: blank PDF project loads in /edit-new?pdfjs=1
tests.summary: Precondition for the whole suite. A blank PDF opens in the pdf.js editor with the page rendered, the Sign button available, the signature modal present but closed, and the saved-signature library hydrated from localStorage.

tests.title: Sign toolbar button opens the signature modal in Draw mode
tests.summary: Clicking Sign opens the modal on the Draw tab with default copy, disabled Apply/Save, composer defaults reset, and no stacked modals or duplicated listeners when opened twice.

tests.title: Modal shell: tab switching, close paths, state reset between opens
tests.summary: Draw/Type/Upload tabs swap panels, hints, apply labels and canvas cursor; strokes survive a tab round-trip; the modal closes via close button, Cancel, scrim and Esc; reopening resets the composer to defaults.

tests.title: Draw tab: stroke capture and pointer event handling
tests.summary: Strokes paint exactly under the pointer on the CSS-scaled canvas, commit on release, survive pointerleave/pointercancel, and are ignored outside Draw mode. Covers mouse, trackpad, touch and stylus.
tests.automation_note: Mouse and synthetic touch pointers are automated, including the CSS-scaled offset check. A real stylus still needs a manual pass.

tests.title: Draw tab: ink colour, stroke width and smoothing controls
tests.summary: Colour and width apply to new/in-progress strokes only; smoothing repaints every existing stroke. Readouts track the inputs and extremes produce no NaN or blank canvas.

tests.title: Type tab: text entry, font list and webfont loading
tests.summary: All 12 script fonts lazy-load and render distinctly, rapid font switching never lets a stale render win, and blocked or slow Google Fonts still fall back within ~2s without hanging.
tests.automation_note: All 12 fonts, the rapid-switch race and the blocked-fonts fallback are automated. Subjective "does it look like a signature" remains manual.

tests.title: Type tab: font size, ink colour and auto-fit shrink
tests.summary: Size 48-180 rescales live, colour recolours the whole mark, and long names step down in 4px increments to fit 82% of canvas width with a 24px floor. Covers unicode, CJK and emoji.

tests.title: Upload tab: valid image import and normalisation
tests.summary: PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/SVG all normalise to PNG, downscale the largest edge to 2048px, preserve aspect and alpha, never upscale, and report normalised dimensions in the filename label.
tests.automation_note: PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/SVG import, 2048px downscale, no-upscale, alpha preservation and PNG re-encoding are automated. Visual fidelity per format remains manual.

tests.title: Upload tab: invalid, oversized and hostile files
tests.summary: Non-images, corrupt files, 0-byte files and 50MB images fail gracefully with a readable status and no stuck composer. SVG with script or remote refs must not execute or fetch.
tests.automation_note: Non-image, empty, corrupt and disguised files plus SVG script/remote-fetch safety are automated. A 50MB stress import remains manual.

tests.title: Preview stage: Clear button, transparent trim and dirty-state gating
tests.summary: Clear resets per-mode state; placed marks are cropped to the ink bounding box plus ~5% padding using an alpha>8 threshold; Apply and Save enable only when the active mode really has content.
tests.automation_note: Clear, dirty-state gating and the exact trim padding are automated. The alpha<=8 faint-stroke threshold is still manual.

tests.title: Saved library: saving signatures to the account
tests.summary: Entries save newest-first with thumbnail, mode label and date; Enter in the name field saves; the library caps at 8 and drops the oldest; duplicates stay independent.
tests.automation_note: RETARGETED. The original subtask described the per-browser localStorage library, which NK_Dev_4 removed. These now cover the account-backed library. The /saved-signatures endpoints are stubbed so the client is tested deterministically; the server contract (ownership isolation, limits, validation) is covered by tests/Feature/SavedSignatureTest.php.

tests.title: Saved library: load and delete account entries
tests.summary: Loading restores the entry's original mode and every setting; delete removes only that row; the library survives reload, is shared across tabs and is per-browser rather than per-document.
tests.automation_note: RETARGETED to the account library, as above. Cross-browser persistence is inherent to account scoping and is covered server-side.

tests.title: Saved library: signed-out state and untrusted entry data
tests.summary: Blocked storage and quota errors roll back cleanly with an error status; corrupt localStorage payloads degrade to empty; hostile entry names render escaped and never execute.
tests.automation_note: RETARGETED. localStorage quota/rollback no longer applies; this now covers the signed-out (401) path and escaping of untrusted entry names.

tests.title: Placement: click-to-place sizing, clamping and cancel
tests.summary: Signatures place centred on the click at 180pt target width capped to 34% page width and 18% page height, clamp to a 12pt margin, auto-select, and cancel via Esc or a non-page click.

tests.title: Placement across zoom, page rotation, multi-page and scroll
tests.summary: Highest-risk area of the pdf.js port: viewport-pixel to PDF-point conversion across 50-300% zoom, 90/180/270 rotation, multi-page targeting and page virtualisation recycling.
tests.automation_note: Zoom, multi-page targeting and scroll/virtualisation are automated. Page rotation is NOT: the editor rotates pages through the server-side page-manager flow, which needs its own harness. Rotation still needs a manual pass.

tests.title: Placed signature: select, move, resize, lock and z-order
tests.summary: Selection exposes the signature-only menu; dragging and all 8 resize handles behave at every zoom; locking refuses mutation; front/back ordering survives save, reload and export.

tests.title: Placed signature: copy and delete
tests.summary: Copies offset ~12px, stay independent and unlocked, clamp inside the page, and survive save/reload. Delete works via menu and keyboard, is refused when locked, and stays deleted.

tests.title: Edit an existing signature: double-click round-trip per mode
tests.summary: Double-click reopens the composer in the annotation's original mode with every setting restored, updates in place without moving or resizing, and supports converting between modes.

tests.title: Undo / redo history for every signature operation
tests.summary: Place, replace, copy, delete, move, resize, lock and reorder each push a snapshot that undo reverts and redo reapplies exactly, including deep sequences and redo-stack invalidation.

tests.title: Save and reload persistence via /save-annotation-state
tests.summary: Every signature round-trips through the save endpoint with geometry, lock state and composer data intact, and handles offline saves, double submits, large base64 payloads and two-tab concurrency.
tests.automation_note: Autosave round trip, payload completeness, composer data and reload fidelity are automated. Offline/500 handling, double-submit and two-tab concurrency are still manual.

tests.title: Burn into PDF and downloaded-PDF fidelity
tests.summary: Burning flattens at the exact on-screen geometry and removes the overlay; downloaded PDFs render correctly in Acrobat, Chrome, Preview and mobile across page sizes, rotation and print.
tests.automation_note: Signatures are deliberately NOT burnable (canBurnAnnotation allows only shapes and freehand draw), so the test asserts that contract rather than the subtask's burn step. Export is covered via the download endpoint. Rendering fidelity in Acrobat/Preview/mobile and print output remain manual.

tests.title: Accessibility and keyboard behaviour
tests.summary: Dialog semantics, focus movement and trapping, full keyboard operation of every control, screen-reader announcement of status changes, and AA contrast at 200% zoom.
tests.automation_note: Dialog and tablist semantics, roving tabindex, arrow-key navigation, keyboard reachability, the live region and accessible names are automated. Actual screen-reader announcement quality and colour-contrast measurement remain manual.

tests.title: Regression: legacy /edit-new parity, cross-tool interference and load
tests.summary: Parity with the non-pdfjs editor, no interference with text/image/shape/field tools, correct signature-annotation vs signature-field separation, plus 20-signature load and memory checks.
tests.automation_note: Cross-tool interference, placement cancellation, bulk load and modal-cycle leaks are automated. Parity with the legacy /edit-new editor, other browsers and real mobile devices remain manual.

tests.title: Retired copy is gone from the modal
tests.summary: None of the four retired lines appear on any tab, in the footer status, or after drawing, clearing and switching tabs.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated: all four retired lines checked on every tab, in the footer status, and after drawing and clearing.

tests.title: No subtext under the live preview
tests.summary: No hint line, no paragraph under the Live preview heading and no smoothing helper text; the heading, Save and Clear all remain.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated: hint, stage copy and smoothing helper checked absent on every tab, with the heading/Save/Clear still present and the mode still discoverable from the tab and Apply label.

tests.title: Stroke width supports a much heavier maximum
tests.summary: The slider runs 1-24, the maximum paints a visibly heavier line, extremes are safe, and the choice is remembered.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated, including that a heavy stroke still trims, places, and persists its width for later editing.

tests.title: Live preview area is larger with less surrounding padding
tests.summary: The white drawing rectangle is materially taller and the padding around it reduced, without pushing the footer off or overlapping the actions.
tests.automation_note: Canvas size, padding, footer overlap, viewport fit and the full-width Saved tab are automated. Small viewports and 200% browser zoom remain a manual look.

tests.title: Modal reopens on the tab you last used
tests.summary: The last tab is restored on reopen and across a reload, a fresh profile still starts on Draw, and edit mode still overrides it.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated: fresh profile, each tab, the Saved view, a full reload, and the edit-mode override.

tests.title: Composer settings are remembered, content is not
tests.summary: Ink, stroke width, smoothing, font, size and layout persist; the drawn/typed/uploaded content is always cleared so a signature is never reused by accident.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated: every setting, content clearing, Clear preserving settings, and a corrupt preferences value falling back to defaults. Fully blocked site data remains manual.

tests.title: Saved tab starts in grid and can switch to row
tests.summary: Grid is the default multi-column layout, the toggle switches to rows, aria-pressed follows, and the choice is remembered.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated: grid default and real multi-column layout, row mode being one-per-line, the remembered choice, actions in both layouts, and the empty state in both. Long names at narrow widths remain a manual look.

tests.title: Typeahead search filters saved signatures as you type
tests.summary: Filtering happens per keystroke, matches case-insensitively anywhere in the name, widens as characters are deleted, and shows a dedicated no-match state.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated, including case-insensitive substring matching, regex-like characters treated literally, search in row mode, actions acting on the filtered entry, and the field disabled when signed out.

tests.title: Rename a saved signature
tests.summary: Inline rename opens focused and pre-filled; Enter and blur commit, Escape abandons, empty names are refused, and the new name survives a reload.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated: focused pre-filled editor, Enter and focus-loss commit, Escape abandon, empty name refused, entry stays intact, and hostile names escaped. Server rules are covered by tests/Feature/SavedSignatureTest.php.

tests.title: Font size determines how large the signature is placed
tests.summary: A 48px font places a genuinely small signature rather than a blurry one scaled to a fixed width; page caps and margins still hold.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated for typed and drawn marks, including that caps, margins and the minimum size still hold. Perceived sharpness in an exported PDF remains a manual look.

tests.title: Aspect ratio is preserved at every placed size
tests.summary: Both axes scale by the same factor, so small and large marks keep their proportions instead of being squashed by the size floors.
tests.automation_note: Fully automated across wide/short, tall/narrow, minimum-clamped and cap-clamped marks. Visual comparison against the preview and the export remains manual.

tests.title: Canvas is tinted for contrast with the ink colour
tests.summary: The composer canvas is grey for dark ink and dark for pale ink, judged perceptually, and the tint is CSS only so the bitmap stays transparent and the placed signature is still trimmed to its ink.
tests.automation_note: Runner test nk5-12-canvas-backdrop plus 9 unit tests in canvas-backdrop.test.mjs. Appearance against a real PDF page remains a manual look.

tests.title: Standard accounts are limited to five saved signatures
tests.summary: A standard account keeps 5 and is refused a sixth by the server with the allowance named; an active pdf-editor subscription keeps 20. Lapsed and wrong-product subscriptions do not raise it.
tests.automation_note: Runner test nk5-13-standard-limit for the browser flow, plus 7 server tests covering the tiers, lapsed and wrong-product subscriptions, admins and the guest fallback. The upgrade wording is worth a manual look.
